content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new here so apologies if these questions are basic. I've recently obtained a [product_name] (transistor type) for use with test setups involving repetitive tasks. My main question is about connecting proximity sensors to the [product_name]. Should I use PNP or NPN types, and is an inline resistor necessary or is there something else I should consider for proper operation? I've looked through the manual and the website but haven't found clear answers—there was only one other post regarding PNP sensors but it had no replies. Additionally, I'm unsure about the memory blocks with batteries that plug in. The manual and website aren't clear. What is the purpose of the battery module? Should I consider getting a hybrid memory/battery plug-in module if I want to transfer pre-written programs into the [product_name]?

Hello [user_name], For information about NPN and PNP sensors, please check online resources and the attached file. The [product_name] supports both types, but you need to use the corresponding I/O pins: configure as active "high" = "1" (PNP) or active "low" = "0" (NPN, use inverted). The [product_name] Memory Card offers circuit program storage. The Battery Card provides backup for the real-time clock for up to two years. The Memory/Battery Card combines both functions. External storage is usually only necessary if you need to protect your program or want to transfer configurations to one or more [product_name] modules without a PC. Kind regards, [user_name]

Thank you, [user_name], your response and the attachment were very helpful! I'm enjoying programming the [product_name]. I've finished my first program for a repetitive test rig and it's running well. I plan to acquire more [product_name] units to replace the outdated [company_name] PLCs and to utilize plug-in memory modules for easier setup in our department—the costs are very competitive for this reason. Thanks again for your help. I'll post another thread if I have more questions. Best regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for clear advice on which proximity sensor types (PNP/NPN) are compatible with [product_name], and how to select and utilize memory and battery modules. They find official documentation and online resources lacking in clear explanations on these topics. Once set up, the product works reliably, but improved guidance from official sources would be helpful.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward, easy-to-access documentation that clearly explains supported sensor types and expansion modules. They want confidence in choosing compatible input devices and add-ons without the risk of errors during setup.
